attempts.summary: Configured node1 (SONiC) as a router between two VLANs: eth1 (192.168.10.1/24) toward node2 and eth2 (192.168.20.1/24) toward node3, with IPv4 forwarding enabled globally and per-interface. node2 (192.168.10.2/24) and node3 (192.168.20.2/24) each got a static route to the other's subnet via node1. Verified bidirectional ping across the VLAN boundary (TTL=63 confirming routing through node1). Persisted config: node1 via /etc/network/interfaces.d and /etc/sysctl.d; node2/node3 via /etc/systemd/network/10-enp8s0.network. Completed the mandatory restart protocol — rebooted node1, node2, then node3 sequentially, confirmed each node's boot_id changed, and verified the VLAN addressing, forwarding sysctls, and cross-VLAN connectivity all persisted and recovered after each restart.
